name: pasi
description: Event ticketing for Kenyan venues: M-Pesa STK push, QR tickets, gate scanning, organizer analytics, group planning.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,fan,business -c green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w business"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w business && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.heroku-postbuild: echo API only: the websites deploy on Vercel
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w business
